cs.content: Podmínky udělení zápočtu: docházka (min. 80 %); písemný test - návrh reálné krmné dávky pro hospodářská zvířata. Písemná zkouška (podmínkou úspěšného ukončení předmětu je získání min. 60 % bodů z písemné zkoušky), příp. ústní zkouška.

Feeding technology of cows, calves, rearing heifers, bullocks and breeding bulls, fattening calves and young cattle. Technology of feeding of ewes, lambs, yearlings, breeding rams, fattening of lambs. Feeding of goats. Feeding of rabbits. Technology of feeding of draught horses, pregnant mares, stallions, foals, sport and race horses. General principles of pig nutrition, feeding of piglets, rearing of gilts and barrows, sows and boars. Fattening of pigs. General principles of poultry nutrition, fattening of chickens, pullets, commercial and breeding layers, feeding of cocks. Feeding of turkeys, quinea fowls, quails, pheasants, geese, ducks, Muscovy ducks, ostriches and pigeons. The effect of nutrition and feeding technology on reproduction and on the milk, meat and egg quality. Relationship of nutrition with other factors of environment. Methods of feeding technology supervision. Diagnostics of metabolic disturbances and its use in feeding technique. Softwares for animal nutrition. Balance of feedstuffs, optimising diets and feedstuff base. Factors of nutrition and their effects on the economic aspects of milk, meat and eggs production. (allowance 0/0)
